en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a monument in a landscaped garden in front of a multi‑story historic building. The monument is a tall rectangular stone pedestal with an eagle sculpture on top and a relief portrait of a man on its side. At the base of the monument is a wreath with a vertically striped ribbon. Conifer trees and shrubs surround the monument, and windows of the building form the background.
